हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/BwRVKP
show.description: Beauty & the Billionaire is a modern love-hate saga between Kishika, a shy medical student burdened by her family’s debts, and Vikrant Singh, a cold, arrogant billionaire with a dark past. When fate forces Kishika to work as Vikrant’s personal secretary to repay her late father’s loan, sparks ignite between the fiery opposites. What begins as a battle, but slowly turns into a desire, power, and redemption, where love might heal the beast or destroy the beauty forever. Watch now!
